subject: Engineering decisions
title: on-demand redroid and the 540x960 Tamil check
question: What was measured for on-demand redroid and the 540x960 Tamil check?
workload: 2026-10-12 on-demand redroid and the 540x960 Tamil check
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: `wf android up|down` (commit 463bfdb7c): `up` boots rdl with the adopted screen and waits for boot; `down` removes it. Host MemAvailable cost of a running redroid: 813 MB (2556 to 1743 MB); with `down` the idle cost is zero. Compose app service is now `restart: "no"`.

rows: - `wf android up|down` (commit 463bfdb7c): `up` boots rdl with the adopted screen and waits for boot; `down` removes it. Host MemAvailable cost of a running redroid: 813 MB (2556 to 1743 MB); with `down` the idle cost is zero. Compose app service is now `restart: "no"`.

- Tamil run at 540x960@240 (`tamil540-072259`, swipes scaled): uyir-1 scores 99, 98, 96, 99, 99, 97 (identical to 720x1280), uyirmei-k 99, write uyir-a 92, words 96 / 82 (second attempt, first 78) / 92 against 96 / 90 / 88. Decision: keep the smaller screen; the trace reads pixels fine, word-uyir-aa needed a retry (one run, n=1).
